DIAGNOSIS READY: Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV)

I have noted your denial of tinnitus and hearing loss during attacks, which makes Ménière's disease unlikely. The combination of position-dependent vertigo in a 70-year-old woman is classic for BPPV, likely involving the posterior semicircular canal. Based on this clinical picture, the diagnosis is BPPV.
